PLAN "12-Week Fat Loss & Glycaemic Control Program"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "fat loss and glycaemic control"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation & Insulin Sensitivity" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Full Body A + Cardio":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x30 seconds rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Full Body B + Intervals":
        warmup:
          cycling 6m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          leg_raise 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Full Body C + Cardio":

          elliptical 8m

NUTRITION
  ENERGY:
    target "500 kcal daily deficit on average; adjust to 300–400 kcal deficit if fasting glucose <80 mg/dL or symptomatic hypoglycaemia"
  PROTEIN:
    target "1.6–2.0 g/kg body weight per day; distribute across 3–4 meals"
  CARBS:
    target "1.5–2.5 g/kg per day from low-GI, high-fiber sources; cap any single meal to 45–60 g net carbs; pair carbs with protein and fiber"
  FATS:
    target "0.8–1.0 g/kg per day emphasizing mono/polyunsaturated fats"
  FIBER:
    target "25–35 g/day from vegetables, legumes, berries, oats, chia/flax"
  HYDRATION:
    target "2.0–2.5 L/day water; add 0.5 L on training days"
  MEAL_TIMING:
    guidance "3 main meals + 1 optional snack; avoid skipping meals if on metformin; pre-workout 20–30 g protein + 15–30 g low-GI carbs if training >45m; post-workout 25–35 g protein + 30–45 g carbs if glucose >100 mg/dL, else emphasize protein/veg"
  CARB_QUALITY:
    guidance "choose low-GI carbs: steel-cut oats, quinoa, brown rice, sweet potato, lentils, chickpeas, beans, berries, apples; avoid refined sugars and liquid calories"
  FAT_QUALITY:
    guidance "olive oil, avocado, nuts, seeds, fatty fish 2x/week"
  MICRONUTRIENTS:
    guidance "ensure magnesium, vitamin D, potassium; include leafy greens, yogurt, beans, fish; consider RD consult for supplements"
  SAMPLE_DAY:
    breakfast "Greek yogurt (200 g) + chia (15 g) + berries (100 g) + walnuts (15 g) — ~35 g protein, 25 g carbs, 15 g fat"
    lunch "Grilled chicken (140 g) + quinoa (120 g cooked) + mixed greens + olive oil (1 tbsp) — ~40 g protein, 35 g carbs, 15 g fat"
    snack "Cottage cheese (200 g) + cucumber + almonds (15 g) — ~28 g protein, 6 g carbs, 12 g fat"
    dinner "Salmon (150 g) + roasted vegetables + sweet potato (150 g) — ~40 g protein, 35 g carbs, 18 g fat"
  GLUCOSE_MONITORING:
    guidance "check fasting and 2h postprandial; aim <140 mg/dL at 2h; if >180 mg/dL repeatedly, reduce meal carbs by 15–20 g and increase non-starchy veg"
  HYPOGLYCAEMIA_PROTOCOL:
    guidance "if symptoms with glucose <70 mg/dL, take 15 g fast-acting carbs (glucose tabs/juice), recheck in 15 min, repeat if needed; follow with protein + low-GI carb once normalized"
  METFORMIN_NOTES:
    guidance "take with meals to reduce GI upset; monitor B12 annually"
  WEEKLY_HABITS:
    habits "- 7,000–10,000 steps/day
- 7–8 h sleep, keep consistent schedule
- Alcohol max 3 drinks/week, with food
- Two fiber-rich vegetables at lunch and dinner
- Plan meals ahead; keep protein-forward snacks on hand"
  ADHERENCE_TIPS:
    guidance "use plate method: half non-starchy veg, quarter lean protein, quarter low-GI carbs; pre-log meals; prepare 2–3 batch-cooked proteins and grains weekly"
  PROGRESSION:
    guidance "if weekly average weight loss >1% BW for 2 weeks, add 25–50 g carbs/day or reduce cardio by 20%; if <0.25% BW for 2 weeks, reduce carbs by 25–40 g/day or add 10 m Zone 2 once"
  PRE_TRAINING_GLUCOSE:
    guidance "if <90 mg/dL before exercise, take 15–20 g low-GI carbs with protein; if >250 mg/dL with ketones (if checked), postpone moderate/vigorous exercise and hydrate"
  POST_TRAINING_GLUCOSE:
    guidance "if >180 mg/dL 30–60 min post, take 10–15 m easy walking; prioritize low-GI carb with protein at next meal"
  CHECK_INS:
    cadence "weekly body weight average, waist, fasting glucose; adjust calories/carbs accordingly"
